{{Quote|Today's race is brought to you by Tradium-brewed Vinta Harvest Ale.|[[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 14">[[Star Wars (1998) 14|''Star Wars'' (1998) 14]]</ref>}}
'''Tradium''' was a company that specialized in the production of special [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] fuels designed for maximum power.

In addition, the company also brewed [[Vinta Harvest Ale]]. They apparently worked alongside [[Vinta Corporation]] in the sale of the popular drink, since it sponsored the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].
